name: Hibino Kouichi
source:
Kouichi is a second year student and [url=/c28843]Shuuji[/url]'s first friend since he arrived in high school and is also his classmate with [url=/c23423]Itsuki[/url], [url=/c46882]Shinobu[/url] and [url=/c23424]Aoi[/url]. Intelligent and voluntary in high school life, Kouichi has the reputation of a very serious student. 

Like many, he had heard of the violent reputation of the Demon of Hayabara, a lonely brawler. However, he and Shuuji quickly became sympathetic the day they met outside of school in a video game store. Sharing the same passion, Kouichi spent all his free time playing strategy games in Shuuji's room, which gave rise to an unpleasant rumor that they were in a relationship.

Like many boys at school, he is jealous that Itsuki, the most beautiful girl in the school, has become his girlfriend.

Surprisingly, though, having spent more than a year playing video games in Shuuji's room, Kouichi never noticed that his friend and Aoi were cousins and lived under the same roof.

[spoiler]Knowing Shuuji and having a great experience of Otome games, he is one of the first to wonder if Shuuji's relationship with Itsuki is really real.[/spoiler]
